svg.title: IEC 60320 C13 connector (female), mating face
svg.desc: Schematic front view of the connector body, chamfered corners at the top. Earth contact slot (PE) at top centre, set higher than the two pole slots at lower left and lower right. The pole slots are not assigned to line or neutral by the cited sources and are labelled L/N. Outlined slots are female contacts. Proportions follow the front view of the Schurter 4782 datasheet (drawn there with the chamfers on the left); not to scale.
